skill_name: Name five aspects of a data science process
workflow: The five aspects of a data science process are: (1) data collection and exploration; (2) data processing and cleaning; (3) feature engineering; (4) data modeling; and (5) evaluation and deployment. Data collection and exploration involve gathering and exploring the data to gain an understanding of it.
